02.04.
2026
WPMS No.785 of 2026
Hon’ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.
This writ petition has been filed challenging 
the order dated 19.01.2026, passed by learned 
IIIrd Additional District Judge, Haridwar in 
Miscellaneous Case No.206 of 2025, “Nirmal Das 
alias Nishant Kumar vs. Rajkumar Das alias 
Ramcharan”, whereby, the learned Additional 
District Judge has allowed the Application, filed 
under Order XLI Rule 21 read with Section 151 of 
the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, and after 
setting aside the judgment and decree dated 
20.04.2022, learned Judge has restored the Civil 
Appeal No.43 of 2017, “Mahant Sita Dasi vs. 
Nirmal Das” to its original number.
2. Heard Mr. Neeraj Garg, learned counsel for 
the petitioner.
3. The case of the respondent was although 
the appellate court had passed an order to issue 
a court notice, no court notice was issued to him 
and due to the COVID-19 pandemic, he could not 
contact his counsel.
4. In the facts and circumstances of the case, 
it would be appropriate to grant an opportunity of 
hearing to the respondent also even before 
passing any order on Admission.  5. Notice is being issued to the respondent. 
Steps to be taken within three days by all the 
permissible modes including dasti, as prayed.
6. List on 10.04.2026.
(Alok Kumar Verma, J.) 
02.04.2026
Pant/
